description: PortCall+ is a port call data service that gathers vessel movement data from port community systems, AIS and algorithms and standardises it into one data model, so users get uniform port call data from several ports. Qronoport announced on 24 October 2022 that the API would be offered on the NxtPort International digital marketplace through a collaboration with Port+. The API provides the available data about a vessel and its voyages within a port: previous, next, destination and origin ports; voyages in, shift and out with the responsible agent; entry, exit and berth locations with estimated and actual times; predefined passages such as Vlissingen for custom in-port logic; and vessel details such as IMO number, call sign and tonnage. Coverage: the ports of Antwerp-Bruges, Gent, Vlissingen (Flushing), Amsterdam and Rotterdam at the time of the announcement. Format and access: a real-time API with data pushed to users, through the NxtPort marketplace. Licence and cost: commercial; no price is published. Caveats: the page is a 2022 announcement, so current coverage and terms must be checked with the provider. It supplies port call and berth time series for capacity planning and port digital twin models. It relates to the VesselFinder port calls API and the World Port Index in the catalogue.
